sanskrit_verse:
कायिका कर्मसंयुक्ता मासाद् ग्राह्या च कालिका ।
वृद्धेर् वृद्धिश् चक्रवृद्धिः कारिता ऋणिना कृता ॥
transliteration: kāyikā karmasaṃyuktā māsād grāhyā ca kālikā / vṛddher vṛddhiś cakravṛddhiḥ kāritā ṛṇinā kṛtā //
sph_interpretive_translation: Interest arising from bodily action connected to time-bound debt obligations shall be recognized as cyclically compounding, initiated by the debtor's own causal engagement.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates in conscious causation, not institutional decree
Responsibility arises through volitional participation in karmic structures
Capacity-based liability is determined by active involvement in transactional cycles
Restoration occurs through alignment with natural consequence flows
Consciousness realignment supersedes punitive financial models
executable_legal_axioms: IF a debtor engages in a time-bound contractual obligation THEN interest accrual is activated automatically based on predefined temporal cycles
IF interest compounds cyclically THEN it must reflect proportional causality traceable to original voluntary act
IF repayment capacity diminishes THEN restructuring protocols initiate without punitive measures
IF debt cycle repeats THEN root-causal review triggers integrity reintegration procedures
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this principle establishes that compound interest laws derive validity solely from the conscious initiation of contractual engagement. The court must ensure that all automated compounding mechanisms maintain direct causal linkage to the debtor's willful entry into the agreement, preserving capacity-sensitive recalibration paths.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: This verse aligns with Nyaya pramāṇa by establishing clear sequential causality: bodily engagement → temporal binding → cyclical consequence. It upholds anupūrvaśaḥ by tracing compound effects back to their originating acts. Responsibility remains proportional to conscious choice, and punitive escalation is replaced by completion-focused restructuring aligned with dharma-sattva balance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate causal mapping process to reconnect debtor with origin intent of contract
Deploy temporal reset protocols allowing recalibration of repayment terms within dharmic capacity
Engage cyclic awareness training to dissolve repetitive debt patterns at source level
Activate community-based support circuits ensuring economic alignment without shame or coercion
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This ruling restores economic justice through consciousness-led causality. No punishment arises—only completion, alignment, and return to dharmic flow. Reality itself adjudicates; consciousness confirms.
